name: p5_1_a_smallest
nat_lang_statement: Write a method double smallest(double x, double y, double z), returning the smallest of the arguments.

dafny.method_signature: p5_1_a_smallest(x: real, y: real, z: real) returns (smallest: real)
ensures: smallest <= x && smallest <= y && smallest <= z
smallest == x || smallest == y || smallest == z

name: p5_4_middle
nat_lang_statement: Write a method public static String middle(String str) that returns a string containing the middle character in str if the length of str is odd, or the two middle characters if the length is even. For example, middle("middle") returns "dd".

ensures: if |str| % 2 == 1 then middleStr[0] == str[|str| / 2] else middleStr == str[|str| / 2 - 1 .. |str| / 2 + 1]

name: p5_4_middle_array
nat_lang_statement: Write a method public static String middle(String str) that returns a string containing the middle character in str if the length of str is odd, or the two middle characters if the length is even. For example, middle("middle") returns "dd".

ensures: if str.Length % 2 == 1 then middleStr.Length == 1 else middleStr.Length == 2
if str.Length % 2 == 1 then middleStr[0] == str[str.Length / 2] else middleStr[..] == str[str.Length / 2 - 1 .. str.Length / 2 + 1]

name: p5_5_repeat
nat_lang_statement: Write a method public static String repeat(String str, int n) that returns the string str repeated n times. For example, repeat("ho", 3) returns "hohoho".

dafny.method_signature: p5_5_repeat(str: seq<char>, n: nat) returns (repeatedStr: seq<char>)
ensures: forall i :: 0 <= i < n ==> repeatedStr[i * |str| .. (i + 1) * |str|] == str

name: p5_5_repeat_array
nat_lang_statement: Write a method public static String repeat(String str, int n) that returns the string str repeated n times. For example, repeat("ho", 3) returns "hohoho".

dafny.method_signature: p5_5_repeat_array(str: array<char>, n: nat) returns (repeatedStr: array<char>)
ensures: forall i :: 0 <= i < n ==> repeatedStr[i * str.Length .. (i + 1) * str.Length] == str[..]

name: p5_6_countVowels_array
nat_lang_statement: Write a method public static int countVowels(String str) that returns a count of all vowels in the string str. Vowels are the letters a, e, i, o, and u, and their uppercase variants.

ensures: (forall c :: c in str[..] ==> (c == 'a' || c == 'e' || c == 'i' || c == 'o' || c == 'u' || c == 'A' || c == 'E' || c == 'I' || c == 'O' || c == 'U')) ==> vowelCount == str.Length

nat_lang_statement: Write a method public static int countWords(String str) that returns a count of all words in the string str. Words are separated by spaces. For example, countWords("Mary had a little lamb") should return 5.

name: p5_8_scramble
nat_lang_statement: Write a method String scramble(String word) that constructs a scrambled version of a given word, randomly flipping two characters other than the first and last one. Then write a program that reads words and prints the scrambled words.

ensures: forall i :: 0 <= i < |word| ==> word[i][0] == scrambled[i][0] && word[i][|word[i]| - 1] == scrambled[i][|scrambled[i]| - 1]

name: p5_8_scramble_array
nat_lang_statement: Write a method String scramble(String word) that constructs a scrambled version of a given word, randomly flipping two characters other than the first and last one. Then write a program that reads words and prints the scrambled words.

requires: 1 <= word.Length && forall w :: w in word[..] ==> 1 <= |w|
ensures:
forall i :: 0 <= i < word.Length ==> word[i][0] == scrambled[i][0] && 
  word[i][|word[i]| - 1] == scrambled[i][|scrambled[i]| - 1]
